eps.t: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-1: Rap is a Man's Soul! (Dai-Gurren-Dan Theme)
eps.ov: In a medieval Europe setting, Simon, Kamina and Viral infiltrate a castle where Nia is held captive by a Grand Zamboa-like enemy. Viral's wife and Yoko also make appearances.

eps.t: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-2: BafBaf! Do You Like Being That... Fired Up!!
eps.ov: Viral encounters a pachinko Gunmen, and then unleashes it on Kamina, Yoko and Simon.

eps.t: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-3: Boing vs. Boing
eps.ov: A version of the series in an artistically-stylized medieval Japan setting.

eps.t: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-4: Pierce the Heavens With Your XXX
eps.ov: In a steampunk wild west theme, Viral is a horse riding hero leading the oppressed beastmen against Kamina, riding Dai-Gurren as a roving bandit.

eps.t: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-5: Rap is a Man's Soul! (Kamina's Theme)
eps.ov: A nude Gimmy steals articles of clothing from Simon, Kamina and Yoko using kancho.

eps.t: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-6: To Hell With This Gattai!
eps.ov: In a modern-looking alternate setting, humans pilot Lagann and Gurren against Beastmen-like enemies in Gunmen and then team up with other humans against a Dai-Gunmen.

eps.t: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-7: Libera Me From Hell
eps.ov: An experimental real world look at the environment of the surface portrayed in the first half of the series, which includes the shadow of a man running and a skull motif, possibly in reference to Kamina's father.

eps.t: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-8: All You Bastards, Get Fired Up!
eps.ov: The story of Lordgenome's past, with the first war against the Anti-Spirals, Lordgenome's descent into madness and the rise of the Beastmen.
